ledger.claim: The platform's own derived geometry records this deviation as ESTABLISHED: the driver's trace runs 26.17 km against a booked optimal of 21.0 km, an excess of 5.17 km, or 24.62%, and both figures clear the POL-RD-01 gates of 0.8 km and 20%. The derived facts were computed in code and the Judge is directed to rely on them rather than recompute the geometry.

For the threshold test the governing distance is gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 26.17 km, not trip_record.actual_distance_km of 26.2 km: POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern and says the rounded trip-record copy may not be cited for the test. The 26.2 km figure on the rider's receipt is therefore not the field either side should argue from.

The rider bears only the initial burden and has discharged it: the trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00108 with a consistent pickup and trip window, and the trace shows excess over the POL-RD-01 threshold. Under POL-RD-08 the burden therefore shifts to the driver to invoke any exculpatory clause by naming a specific artifact and a specific clause.

POL-RD-04 does not rescue the driver either. waypoint_hint is null on every one of the four chat messages and no road is named in any of them, so the corroboration test that clause requires is undecidable on this record and the clause is, on its own terms, unavailable.

POL-RD-05 is an exculpatory clause, and POL-RD-08 lets an exculpatory clause take effect only where the driver points to a specific artifact and a specific clause. The driver's only statement is a general narrative - 'I drove exactly where the app told me' - that names no artifact id and no clause id, and the chat_log names no waypoint or road. On this record the relocation point is not made out and the deviation shown by the trace stands.

The rider does not dispute that the trip_record carries amended_optimal_distance_km 24.60 for the amended Punggol MRT to Terminal 3 endpoints, and accepts that if POL-RD-05 is applied the excess over that figure is only 1.57 km, or 6.4% - below the POL-RD-01 threshold. The rider's position is confined to this: that clause is the driver's to invoke and is invoked nowhere by him, and if the Judge applies it the arithmetic must run on the stored amended figure of 24.60 km and not on the 26.2 km receipt line.

No traffic advisory is on file, so POL-RD-03 cannot exonerate the driver. The only advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00108-01, is MISSING with no payload and an admissibility weight of 0.0; I disclose that weight - this claim relies on the absence of the artifact, not on its contents, and the driver has pleaded no closure in any event.

ledger.claim: The rider's own profile does not trigger the added corroboration requirement in POL-RD-08: her deviation_claims_60d is 1, far below the four-claim trigger paired with one or fewer substantiated, so no independent source beyond the trace is required to carry her claim past the burden stage.

The trip record shows both endpoints were amended after booking: the pickup was moved from Blk 118 Rivervale Dr, Sengkang to Punggol MRT PHV Pickup Bay at 07:12:30 (pickup_amended_at), and the dropoff was changed from Changi T1 Departure Door 3 to Changi T3 Departure Door 7 at 07:41:52 (dropoff_amended_at). Under POL-RD-05 the POL-RD-01 threshold test must therefore be re-applied against the optimal route between the AMENDED endpoints - trip_record.amended_optimal_distance_km of 24.60 km with amended_optimal_duration_min of 31.0, both stored fields and both non-null - and not against the 21.0 km booked T1 route that the rider's receipt quotes. The rider's 'usually 21 km' figure is the superseded pre-amendment baseline.

Measured against the amended baseline the excess is 26.17 km of governing trace distance (gps_trace.trace_distance_km) less the 24.60 km amended optimal, i.e. about 1.57 km, which is roughly 6.4% of the amended optimal route. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess exceeds 20% of optimal_distance_km AND exceeds 0.8 km absolute, and both tests must pass. The percentage gate fails decisively on the amended figure, so no deviation is established on this trip and the outcome is NO_ACTION.

Both amendments were the rider's own doing and sit verbatim in the chat log: at 07:11:58 she wrote 'im at punggol mrt phv pickup bay instead, moved the pin', which the driver acknowledged at 07:12:15, and at 07:41:40 she wrote 'sorry ah can change to T3? my friend flight is T3 not T1', which the driver acknowledged at 07:42:05. The additional distance and the terminal change the rider now complains of are rider-caused, which is precisely the situation POL-RD-05 addresses - a rider moving the pin and a rider giving a different destination in the chat_log.

The rider's own complaint that the driver 'drove around the airport for another five minutes' is the circling at the amended T3 dropoff - a point she had only just moved to, at which the driver reports she was not at the kerb. POL-RD-05 excludes exactly this distance: where the rider was not at the amended point and the gps_trace shows the vehicle circling within 400 m of it for more than 4 minutes, that circling distance is also excluded from excess. The admissibility note on EV-GPS-00108 records two loops of the T3 departure kerb well inside 380 m of the amended pin, and the rider's own account of about five minutes of circling corroborates the duration. I note that derived.arrival is unavailable on this bundle because trip_record.pickup_zone_class is null, so this point rests on the trace summary and the rider's own admission rather than on a computed dwell.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold. On the amended route the excess is 1.57 km and 6.4%, which does not meet that threshold, so the burden never shifts to the driver and no exculpatory clause needs to be reached. The rider's assertion that the trip 'is usually about 21 km' measures against the superseded booked route rather than the amended endpoints actually driven, which is a wrong-field comparison and fails on that ground alone.

The GPS trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 206 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps list and a maximum gap of 0 seconds. None of POL-RD-07's impairment limbs (a) to (c) is met, so no independent corroboration requirement attaches and the trace's own distance figure governs the POL-RD-01 test.

No repeat-deviation pattern is established against this driver. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 across driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 402, a ratio of 0.00, far below the 0.05 limb of POL-RD-06, and the 3-or-more limb is not met either. POL-RD-06 therefore supplies no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral on this record. I flag for the Judge that driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and is NOT the trailing-90-day field POL-RD-06 names, so it cannot be substituted for it under POL-GEN-01.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the contested charge is SGD 33.77 (EV-FARE-00108, charged_total). The trip was booked Blk 118 Rivervale Drive → Changi Terminal 1 on a 21.0 km optimal route, but the record shows the endpoints were amended twice, both at the rider's own request: the pickup was moved to Punggol MRT at 07:12:30 and the dropoff was changed from T1 to T3 at 07:41:52 (EV-TRIP-00108; EV-CHAT-00108, MSG-00108-001 and MSG-00108-003, each acknowledged by the driver). Under POL-RD-05 the deviation test is re-run against the route between the amended endpoints — the stored amended_optimal_distance_km of 24.60 km with amended_optimal_duration_min of 31.0 — and not the superseded 21.0 km figure the rider's receipt quotes. Measured on that baseline, the governing GPS distance (EV-GPS-00108, trace_distance_km 26.17 km, weight 1.0) exceeds the amended optimal by 1.57 km, which is 6.4% of it. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess exceeds BOTH 20% of the optimal distance AND 0.8 km absolute; the percentage gate fails, so no deviation is established. POL-RD-05 directs NO_ACTION where no deviation survives the recomputation, and because no deviation is established POL-RD-02's fare recomputation does not run and no distance or time refund issues; the charge stands.

Rider's points. (1) The 'usually about 21 km' comparison measures against the pre-amendment route the vehicle did not drive, so it is a wrong-baseline comparison and is rejected on that ground. (2) The derived deviation status 'established' at 5.17 km / 24.6% (EV-GPS-00108) was computed against the booked 21.0 km baseline and predates the POL-RD-05 re-baselining, so it does not displace the amended figure; the deciding arithmetic is the amended 24.60 km. (3) The rider's account of roughly five minutes circling at T3 is the kind of distance POL-RD-05 also excludes from excess, and it points the same way, but it is not needed because the excess is already below both gates. (4) The contention that the driver never invoked POL-RD-05 does not survive: the driver's brief cites POL-RD-05 together with EV-TRIP-00108, EV-GPS-00108 and EV-CHAT-00108, and in any event the clause re-baselines the analysis on the record itself.

Driver's points. The no-repeat-pattern finding is accepted: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 across 402 completed trips in 90 days, so POL-RD-06 supplies no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral, and prior_deviation_flags is context-only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used. The GPS trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (206 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, empty gaps, max gap 0 s), so POL-RD-07's independent-corroboration requirement never attaches and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. There is no billing-integrity defect: no airport surcharge is charged (correct, because this trip ENDS at Changi rather than originating there), ERP and tolls are zero, and the fare lines reconcile to the cent against SGD 33.77, so POL-RD-09(4) yields no standalone refund and no referral. No driver compensation arises either: the billed 26.2 km is not less than the trace distance, so POL-RD-04's unbilled-kilometre shortfall limb has nothing to bite on.

No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, trip_id TRP-00108 matches across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, the trace is unimpaired, the amendment re-quote is present and non-null, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. Confidence is 0.95, capped at 1.0 by the two independent weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding fact (EV-TRIP-00108 for the amended optimal and EV-GPS-00108 for the trace distance).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
